title: Gotrade Daily: After Dell's Beat, PCE Tests the Market
summary: Dell beat estimates, but chip stocks fell again on Tuesday. Tonight, October PCE inflation data is the next test before Thanksgiving.
body_markdown:
### Workday, Nvidia and Deere


**Workday ([WDAY](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/wday/) )** reported adjusted earnings of $2.82 per share on revenue of $2.71 billion, above the LSEG estimates of $2.74 and $2.69 billion. Third-quarter free cash flow of $691 million missed the $712 million estimate,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stocks-moving-the-most-today-live-updates.html) .


**Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** fell the day after its 31.48% rally on Monday. At his first all-hands since returning, Huang told staff the company does not need succession planning, according to a source cited by[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


**Deere & Company ([DE](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/de/) )** reports fiscal Q4 results before the open, with a consensus estimate of $4.07 per share, according to the[Nasdaq earnings calendar](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of CNBC's 11:01 p.m. ET update on Tuesday, Dow futures were down 68 points, or 0.1%, S&P 500 futures were down 0.2% and Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.3%. In Asia on Wednesday, South Korea's Kospi plunged 4.49%,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html) .


## Macro Note 📝


At 8:30 a.m. ET, the October PCE price index is due along with the second estimate of Q3 GDP, according to the[BEA schedule](https://www.bea.gov/news/schedule) . Economists polled by Dow Jones expect PCE to rise 0.3% for the month and 3.8% annually,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html) . It is the final inflation reading before the Fed's December meeting, and markets see a 25 basis point rate hike as all but certain,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


Weekly jobless claims are also due today, a day earlier than usual because of Thanksgiving.


## Conclusion


Dell beat estimates, but chip stocks fell again. Tonight, PCE data tests the market ahead of the Fed's December meeting.


US markets are closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving and close early on Friday,[according to the NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars) .
